name: fz518_outrage_sub
purpose: Outrage into a Substitute (issue 518): Tauros, p2a, breaks Lycanroc's Substitute with Outrage (step 1). selfDrops puts the lockedmove volatile on the user for the null target too (sim/battle-actions.ts:1317-1335; data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:349-352), so the lock's count is drawn (random(2, 4), data/conditions.ts lockedmove onStart). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_116_36), cut after its step 1: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
